scientific_integrity: The exact finite algebra computation is accompanied by a replayable SymPy checker; the proof also includes exhaustive projective charts and direct tangent arguments. The value of the exact local Hilbert function does not rely on finite point sampling. No external independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the ordinary Hessian of one singular reduction in characteristic seven, not a positive-characteristic Wronskian or a complete family degeneration. The classical equation and known A6 cusp are not new. Specialized historical literature may contain an equivalent Hessian intersection calculation.
title: The length-\(21\) Hessian collision on the characteristic-seven Klein quartic
